purpose: Ranger fixed-COM force-stage continuation from the validated 8000-iteration baseline

domain_randomization.com: fixed at checkpoint training nominal asset COM; no COM randomization

algorithm.rng: restore torch, numpy and python states from checkpoint after environment construction

stop_rule: Stop at iteration 9000 after the first 1000 force-stage iterations; do not auto-extend. Consider a separately authorized second 1000 only after reviewing force RMSE vs per-trace zero baseline, nonzero vector error, sustained zero-force false positives, end-effector/base control retention and termination.
required_preflight: Verify source checkpoint SHA and 8000/global192000 counters
Verify model and both Adam states restore exactly; verify LR, RNG and PPO update counters
Verify all COM values remain at asset nominal and critic COM deltas are zero
Verify force command and external force are zero through policy step 192000 and nonzero only from 192001
Verify force frame, per-axis bounds, pulse cadence, independent streams and four-substep application
Verify zero-force replay is exact before the first forced step
Verify protected source files and checkpoint SHA are unchanged
limitations: 512 environments are one eighth of the official 4096; this is a Ranger-adapted comparison, not a full official reproduction
Ranger morphology, flat task and implicit PD differ from B2+Z1 source task
PhysX, task, history and episode counters are reconstructed at continuation; this is not bitwise continuous training
No COM randomization is a deliberate user-selected deviation from the official randomization
One training seed; validation trajectories do not count as independent training seeds
Simulation force-stage results do not certify real hardware
